Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner unilaterally redefined “came out earlier” to mean the primary-country wide release date per IMDb, ignoring the earliest verified public release date available for Niyoti (10 June 2016 in West Bengal from Wikipedia and prior findings). This arbitrary criterion change led to comparing Niyoti’s later Bangladesh date (12 Aug 2016) against Angali Pangali’s India date (17 June 2016), producing the wrong conclusion. Under the straightforward interpretation—earliest public release anywhere—Niyoti (10 June 2016) came out earlier than Angali Pangali (17 June 2016).
